verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a hosted email client that syncs mail to its own servers, so data residency is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to choose a storage region or residency. Community comments only note that mail syncs to Shortwave's servers, without mentioning region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
